title: Text models got a clearer shape
summary:
The week made model selection and request handling more predictable while community builders added new ways to make images.

GPT-5 Nano became the default `openai` model, while `openai-fast` stayed on GPT-4.1 Nano. Public listings now omit hidden models and provider identifiers, older entries were removed, and `openai-large` moved to the seed tier. The next day's configuration work made provider settings and transforms easier to follow, with failed transforms falling back to the original request.

`flux` image requests now prefer registered ComfyUI servers, with Cloudflare fallbacks and progress updates as each fallback is tried. Image routing has a clearer plan for when the first choice does not work.

Three image generators joined Creative Projects, offering features including prompt optimization, generation progress, style and resolution controls, and image history. Hack & Build also gained AI Agent Portal, which brings Architect, Coder, and QA agents together around a single development prompt.

System-message support is now set per text model, including DeepSeek Reasoning. The text API root points to its documentation, and a SECURITY.md file explains how to report vulnerabilities privately.
